notes.subject: פים
notes.rationale: פים (pim) em i mak bilong skelim (tupela long tripela sekel) — JPS/BSB ritim olsem pris; KJV ritim 'fail' — Hebrew tok i wanpela tok, mi holim 'pim' olsem mak bilong skelim

notes.subject: הפצירה
notes.rationale: Strong tok i min 'bluntness' (tit i no sap), tasol planti tanim tok i ritim 'fail/pris bilong saepen' — mi holim pasin bilong JPS

notes.subject: פים
notes.rationale: pim em i mak bilong skelim i stap wantaim long Klaus Baibel hia nomo

notes.subject: ולאתים
notes.rationale: אתים hia em i nais bilong gaden (H855), i no aleph-tav marker H853

translation: Na pris bilong saepen i kamap: wanpela pim long ol matok, na long ol nais bilong gaden, na long tripela-tit bilong fok, na long ol akisis, na long sapim ol goad.

tokens.gloss: na long ol nais bilong gaden
